title: Search Intelligence Intern
description: Predictive ranking and decision support on large-scale search and engagement data (a warehouse of about 78.8 million rows), built with Python and DuckDB.
responsibilities: Performed signal validation before any modelling
Generated ranked action queues and reviewed top-ranked pages
Evaluated baseline logic as the benchmark for models
Engineered 26 features and ran leakage audits for the capstone ranking model
achievements: A transparent baseline ranking system, then a leakage-aware Random Forest ranking model that beat a fixed baseline on a held-out future month (Precision@20 of 0.65 against 0.40).
